Markets.title: Trump administration's embrace of "perp" futures sets off risk alarms for Wall Street stalwarts
Markets.summary: The Trump administration's launch of perpetual futures has raised concerns among established exchange leaders and Wall Street firms. Critics argue these products could disrupt market dynamics and should be classified as swaps.

Markets.title: US dollar dips as easing AI and Mideast worries limit its appeal
Markets.summary: The US dollar dropped from a six-month high following strong job growth figures and easing geopolitical and technology concerns. Investors are now awaiting upcoming consumer price index data to gauge the Federal Reserve's next interest rate decisions.

Markets.summary: US stocks rallied, with the Dow Jones gaining 500 points and the Nasdaq rising over 2% as chip stocks rebounded. The market gains occurred despite Nvidia shares facing a decline due to an investigation involving CEO Jensen Huang.

Markets.title: Nvidia sell-off continues: Chipmaker stock plunges 9% as Jensen Huang faces espionage controversy
Markets.summary: Nvidia shares plunged 9% after CEO Jensen Huang acknowledged his relationship with an executive linked to intelligence efforts. The company is investigating the security concerns, while analysts warn that uncertainty surrounding Huang's future threatens Nvidia's ongoing success.

Markets.title: India bonds continue rally ahead of inflation data
Markets.summary: Indian government bond yields dropped on Monday due to falling crude oil prices and optimism surrounding a potential US-Iran peace deal. Investors are now awaiting upcoming US and Indian inflation data to gauge future interest rate trends.

Geo-Political.summary: President Trump stated that the FBI is investigating Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang regarding an alleged affair with a suspected Chinese spy. Trump said he personally spoke with Huang about the matter on Monday.

Geo-Political.title: Nvidia shares tumble over investigation into Huang's affair with alleged Chinese spy

Geo-Political.summary: Delegations from Kyiv, Washington, and Moscow are meeting in the United Arab Emirates for their first trilateral peace talks since February. U.S. officials report that both warring sides are showing some flexibility in the negotiations.

Geo-Political.summary: An abuse survivor says that a modeling agency boss still in business put her in danger by sending her to Jeffrey Epstein's Florida beach home for photoshoots. The woman is speaking out about her experiences with the associate of the late sex offender.

Geo-Political.title: France accuses Iran of supermarket fridge hacking
Geo-Political.summary: France has accused Iran of orchestrating a cyberattack that caused supermarket refrigerators and freezers to heat up last month. This incident resulted in the spoilage of tons of chilled and frozen food across hundreds of stores.

Geo-Political.summary: Republican Representative Thomas Massie plans to force an impeachment vote against Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth. Massie aims to pressure Donald Trump into firing Hegseth before Democrats can initiate their own impeachment proceedings next year.

India.summary: A boy in Delhi's Baljeet Nagar was beaten to death after bursting firecrackers near another juvenile. The fatal assault occurred in the Punjabi Basti area.
